messages:
matt: Heads-up— the espresso machine died mid-shot. It made a sad hissing noise and now it's off. Please don't try to force it.
rebecca: Yikes. I'm 100% for a coffee run. Anyone want something from the bakery?
ash: Can you grab oat barista and a pack of those seed crackers? Running low.
sam: Also the milk fridge is warmer than usual, left a sticky on it. Facilities ticket created.
kiera: If anyone's going to the corner shop, could you pick up tea bags (earl grey) and decaf pods? Thx.
facilities-bot: [auto] Ticket #4567 created for kitchen espresso machine. Assigned to Jorge. ETA 3 hours.
matt: OK I'm heading out in 10. Plan: local bakery for pastries + corner store for milk and pods. DM me for cash.
rebecca: Croissant + 1 oat barista for me. I'll Venmo.
ash: Seed crackers and the oat please.
sam: Pls also grab a small box of wet wipesfor sticky counters.
matt: Inventory quick note posted on the shelf. Coffee pods: 4, Oat: 0, Almond: 2, Seed crackers: 0.
kiera: Love a labeled inventory! When machine is fixed can we add a "do not use" tag to the front? It sparked.
matt: Yep, taped a note already. Back in ~30 with snacks :tada:
rebecca: Bless you :pray::heart:
